title: OOM notification doesn't properly parse unit name
line: When the system runs out of memory and kills a D-Bus activated app like Yakuake, the notification now names the app and offers to restart it.
explanation: Apps started through D-Bus activation run in units named by dbus-broker, like dbus-:1.2-org.kde.yakuake@0.service. unitNameToServiceName() only understood the app-* naming scheme and returned nothing for these, so the OOM notification fell back to showing the raw unit name as a background service. The change also recognises the dbus-<unique name>-<bus name>@<n>.service scheme and returns the bus name, which normally matches the app's desktop file; units without a matching desktop file still show the unit name as before.

commits.message:
oom_notifier: Name D-Bus activated applications

The notification showed the raw unit name of D-Bus activated apps, like
dbus-:1.2-org.kde.yakuake@0.service, since only app-* units were mapped
to a desktop entry. Map dbus-broker's units to their bus name as well.

BUG: 510234

media.caption: Before: an OOM-killed dbus-:1.2-org.kde.konsole@0.service is reported as a background service by its raw unit name
After: the same unit is reported as Konsole, with a Restart Application button

reviews.text: Clean, safe fix in plasma-workspace's shared components/systemd_decode.h that parses dbus-broker's transient unit format (dbus-<unique>-<well-known>@<n>.service) so OOM notifications and MPRIS lookup can resolve D-Bus-activated apps like Yakuake and Konsole to their desktop entries while leaving services without desktop files unaffected. The QStringView slicing preserves hyphens in well-known names and handles malformed inputs cleanly, and the live verification screenshots clearly show the fix. Adding a dbus-: test row to the existing oom_notifier-decodetest.cpp before merging would be a nice optional touch, but the patch itself is MR-ready.

Fixes exactly what the reporter and Nate asked: dbus-broker's dbus-:<unique>-<bus name>@<n>.service units now map to the bus name, which resolves Yakuake/Konsole via serviceForUnitName() and gives the app notification with Restart Application; units without a matching desktop file keep the old text. The change lives in the shared helper in components/systemd_decode.h (right layer, also benefits libkmpris) and is small and safe on QStringView. Before/after screenshots and the regression notes (app-* units, unmatched dbus- names) match the patch and commit message. Nitpicks only: the comment claiming unique names cannot contain '-' is true for bus-generated ':1.N' names rather than by spec, and maintainers may like a case added to the existing oom_notifier-decodetest.
